            end
        end)

    Callback = function()
        local purchaseArgs = {0, "Overkill"}

        local remotePath = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("Backpack"):WaitForChild("OverGlove"):WaitForChild("Event")

                local args = {
                    "slash",

                    Vector3.new(-9999999999999, 9999999999, 999999999999)
